text:
sara_sales: FYI — NovaGuard RFP landed. They want: an executable POC (4 weeks), completed security questionnaire, a capability matrix showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, and firm pricing for embeddings + gen. Need all by EOW (Friday). I uploaded the PDF: https://company-drive/helios/NovaGuard_RFP_2026.pdf

sami_pm: thanks, saw it. big ask on HSM + on-prem packaging. Are we proposing Private or Dedicated for the POC?

_dev note: quick answers preferred — keep bullets._

devin_se: I can lead the POC run. propose: 2-week smoke on Hosted (fast onboarding) then transition to a Dedicated pool for scale testing. That keeps legal teams happy and shows predictable latency.

mike_sol_eng: agree with Devin. For the capability matrix I'll mark fallback routing, KV cache, quantization options, and per-route SLAs. Also need to call out cold-starts for Private deployments.

alice_security: on the questionnaire: we can answer SOC2 & encryption in transit at the S-item level. HSM integration: we support KMIP and cloud-KMS for Hosted/Dedicated; on-prem package can integrate with customer HSM but requires a field install and MSA. I'll draft the HSM answer.

_sara_sales: NovaGuard specifically asked about CCPA and data residency in eu-west-1 and on audit logs retention (7 years)._

alice_security: CCPA — we have controls and data-access logs; EU residency — we can pin region for Hosted or run Private in their VPC. Audit logs 7 years is above our default 1 year retention; need legal signoff for extended retention costs.

mike_sol_eng: Pricing callouts: embeddings: tiered per-1000 vector units; gen: per-token. For POC, we can offer a time-limited dev rate and a committed Dedicated quote for production. I'll attach a sample pricing sheet. (will upload shortly)

sami_pm: timeline ask from NovaGuard: test queries per second ~150 qps, 2s p95 latency target, batch workloads for nightly embeddings. Are those numbers achievable on Dedicated A100 pools?

mike_sol_eng: 150 qps with 2s p95 is feasible with a 4-card A100 pool and batching tuned by sequence length. Need typical prompt length & embedding dims. Ask them for a sample corpus.

devin_se: I'll request sample traffic and a few prompt families. Also want to confirm which model family they want — LlamaX-70B, or a 13B hybrid quantized variant? Smaller model may help meet latency.

sara_sales: I'll ask for corpus and target SLA. Also getting legal to review extended audit retention cost.

alice_security: draft security answers I'm going to include: SOC2 scope, encryption keys flow, key rotation policy, incident response contact, on-prem HSM requirements, data deletion/retention process. Any special compliance (FedRAMP)?

sami_pm: NovaGuard is in healthcare but not a covered entity. They asked about FedRAMP only as a long-term ask. Not required for POC.

mike_sol_eng: attaching capability matrix v1 (internal): /files/capability_matrix_novaguard_v1.xlsx — it enumerates feature parity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, model variants, expected latencies, and soft quotas.

devin_se: sample curl for smoke test (to include in runbook):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-13b", "prompt":"Translate to french: Hello" }'
```

sara_sales: nice. Can we also provide a clear fall-back plan if Private install hits network blocking? e.g., demo on Hosted + encrypted S3 snapshot of prompts for local replay?

mike_sol_eng: yes — fallback plan: run interactive demo on Hosted with pinned EU region, and run offline batch replay on their Private env once HSM & peering are confirmed. Documented in the ops runbook.

alice_security: I'll answer the HSM Q: "We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM. For on-prem HSMs we require an installation window, network access to the control plane endpoints, and an on-site security checklist. We can provide a SOC2 attestation and a network encryption diagram." Will add exact contract language for the MSA.

sami_pm: action items: Devin -> request sample corpus + traffic profile (today). Mike -> finalize capability matrix + pricing sheet (tomorrow). Alice -> draft security questionnaire answers (tomorrow). Sara -> legal escalation for 7yr log retention and send RFP to all stakeholders (today).

sara_sales: thanks team — if we can get draft materials by EOD Thursday we can iterate and send Friday morning. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Reminder: dedicated pool provisioning can take 48-72 hours after signed PO.

devin_se: noted. I'll ask NovaGuard about preferred start date so we can plan provisioning buffer.

sara_sales: perfect. I'll post updates here when I hear back from them.
